title: Chapter 363
text:
You have triggered the mission [Visitor From Afar]!

Mission Introduction: When you saw her for the first time, her eyes were imprinted in your heart. They were like a hazy fog, a dark well, a deep abyss. A voice sounded in your heart, telling you that you wanted to take this woman away.

Mission Requirements: Rescue her from the slave market, keep her by your side, and keep her by your side for six days. Mission completed.

Reward: 1,800,000 Experience and an unknown reward.

"Is this mission introduction going to be a text adventure game?" Han Xiao felt goosebumps all over his body and was speechless.

This woman was definitely not simple. He had never seen this character in his previous life, so he had no impression of her at all. Maybe no players had discovered her before, so she was a hidden character that had not been exposed.

"What's so special about her?" Han Xiao asked curiously.

"The projector shows that her body structure is not that of an ordinary universe race," Horlaide said. "Her body contains the bloodline of some ancient creature. We can't find a matching file, so we don't know what race she is. After the energy detector test, the energy reaction in her body is far beyond that of normal creatures. Her level is constantly fluctuating. The lowest is at least Grade C Super, and the highest is even Grade B …"

"Why is such a strong Super under your control?" Han Xiao was surprised. He pointed at the shackles and self-destruct collar on the woman. "Those things can't kill a Grade B Super."

Horlaide rubbed the jewelry ring with his finger and said with a smile, "Of course, we don't have the ability to control someone above Grade C. However, she doesn't know how to use the energy in her body, so she has no combat ability. Plus, she willingly stayed here."

Han Xiao was stunned.

"There's something wrong with her memory. She can't remember most of her experiences. She only remembers language, but her intelligence level is not that of a baby. She has very high intelligence and can communicate …"

"So, she's someone with amnesia?"

"Haha, it's not as simple as amnesia." Horlaide pointed at his head. "Normal people with amnesia will feel panic and curiosity about their identity and environment. However, her thinking is very strange. She doesn't have the curiosity or impulse to find out who she is, why she's here, or what she wants to do. She doesn't panic because she has no memory. She's like a person who's half awake, peacefully staying here without any thoughts of searching for her memory. Her life form is very special. She doesn't seem to have any instincts or desires. She doesn't need to eat or excrete. What a special individual. "

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. The stranger this woman was, the greater the secret she was hiding. He couldn't help but be curious. "What's her name?"

"I gave her a name, Aroshia Sisolama Doniers …" There were fifty to sixty words in this list of names. Horlaide mumbled for a while before he finished, "… I usually call her Aroshia for short."

The corners of Han Xiao's eyes twitched. You're so poisonous! Why did you come up with such a long name? Did you have nothing better to do?!

Or is it that you, a black-hearted merchant who sells slaves, possess the legendary Golden Chuunibyou Soul?

This sudden quest gave a considerable amount of experience, and there was also an unknown reward. To a certain extent, the reward was proportional to the difficulty. Han Xiao decided to give it a try. Since he couldn't rob her, he would buy her with money. Han Xiao asked, "How much is she selling for?"

Horlaide put on the smile of a businessman. "Not expensive, only 300,000 Enas."

"Goodbye."

Han Xiao turned around and left expressionlessly.

You want to learn from me? Why do you have to make things difficult for me?

Horlaide hurriedly chased after him and yelled, "We can negotiate if you think it's too expensive. How about 200,000 … 100,000? 50,000? Okay, I'll take a loss. I'll sell her to you at least 10,000! "

Han Xiao had a suspicious look on his face. Thirty times discount? How could there be such a thing? As the saying went, if something abnormal happened, there must be something wrong. Thinking about the six-hour time limit in the quest, he suddenly became alert.

After thinking about it, Han Xiao temporarily put this quest aside and continued to test him. "This price is about right, but I still want to buy other rare slaves. Don't you have any other goods?"

Horlaide heard that, grinned, and said, "Haha, you're in luck. I'm going to add a new batch of rare goods. You can come and take a look then."

Han Xiao's heart skipped a beat. This batch of new goods should be the Silvers. Luckily, they weren't delivered yet, so the mercenaries' plan could be implemented.

"That's great! I'll come and take a look at the goods then, and I'll buy that Aroshia too. " Han Xiao pretended to be happy and expressed his sincerity to buy, but he still did not pay. After a few perfunctory words, he was ready to leave. Horlaide had no choice but to let his brother send Han Xiao away.

Horlaide was the only one left in the underground prison corridor. He pouted and mumbled, "What do you mean by paying when the time comes? He definitely doesn't want to buy Aroshia …"

When he took over this slave market, Aroshia was already locked up here. The previous owner told him that he did not need to give her any special treatment and could just sell her normally. However, there was once a customer who bought Aroshia. A few days later, Aroshia, who was taken away, appeared out of thin air in this prison cell, giving him a huge shock. The customer came back angrily, and only then did he know that Aroshia would suddenly disappear on her own after being taken away and mysteriously return to the prison cell.

Horlaide asked the previous owner and found out that Aroshia had already existed not long after Floating Dragon Island was built. The owner at that time reported the situation, and it reached the ears of the Floating Dragon Island's ruler. That willful beyond Grade A boss came over to take a look, and with the principle of 'just kill what you don't understand', he killed Aroshia and turned her into ashes.

However, after a few days, Aroshia appeared again as if nothing had happened. The big boss came over to kill her again. After repeating this more than thirty times, he finally came to the conclusion that this was a Space Wonder, some kind of strange phenomenon that was hard to explain.

According to his observations, only one 'Aroshia' would exist at the same time. If she died, she would suddenly be reborn after a period of time. However, the short-term memories of her previous life would disappear, and she would return to her initial amnesia state. If she left this prison cell, she would also suddenly disappear from somewhere else. No matter what building this was, she would return to the location of the prison cell.

According to the conclusion, regardless of whether she died or was bought, Aroshia would not leave this place for more than six days.

The Floating Dragon Island's ruler was very casual and threw the Space Wonder to the slave market to deal with. Therefore, the owner sold it as a commodity to cheat the buyer of money.

Horlaide shook his head and subconsciously looked at Aroshia's prison cell. Aroshia, who was originally sitting in the corner, was standing in front of the window. Through the window, only a pair of deep and calm eyes could be seen!

Horlaide was startled. After a while, he turned around and left.

In the prison cell, Aroshia's eyes followed Horlaide's figure as he moved.

However, this was a one-sided window, and the scene outside could not be seen from inside the prison cell.

…

"I've asked around. The Silvers are not here yet." Returning to the team, Han Xiao reported the information, and the three leaders were energized.

"Great, we can carry out the rescue plan!" Purple Gold's leader, Cerleni, said. "Time is tight. We don't know when the scavengers will arrive, and we don't know their identities. It's best to split up and ambush at all the main roads leading to the slave market. There's only one chance, so we can't miss any suspicious targets. We have to save the Silvers before they are sold to the market."

The few of them decided to split up and ambush. The ambush location extended from the dock to the slave market, and every street and intersection had to be equipped with mercenaries.

Using the distance from the slave market as a standard, the ambush line could be roughly divided into four layers. The first layer was the furthest, which was the dock, and the fourth layer was the closest to the slave market, which was around the market.

The three leaders considered that Black Star was not afraid of criminals like them, so Han Xiao was assigned to the third layer. This position was slightly safer than the dock where criminals gathered, and Goa's team was responsible for the last layer.
